For past values, the Consumer Price Index tables are the place to look. Table 18-10-0004 (Consumer Price Index, monthly, not seasonally adjusted) covers Ontario and has a rent-related product group. I only identified the table from search results and did not fetch any rent series from it, so please confirm the exact "Rented accommodation" series for Ontario in the table itself.
